settings_navigation.policy: Settings is an App-owned information architecture, not an upstream AionUI configuration dump. Ordinary navigation uses General, Access, Agents & Capabilities, Local Environment, Appearance, Advanced, and About & Updates. About & Updates contains the Updates & Maintenance plane for App binary, runtime/toolchain, agent packages, and capability exposure. Legacy upstream settings routes remain compatibility redirects only; they must not reappear as ordinary navigation. Pages answer user readiness questions first, with raw implementation details behind secondary disclosure.
